description: Unofficial Ascend port of NAVER native DFlash DLoop training
native_loss: rollout-token CE with decay gamma=7, stage-zero/final-stage joint normalization
validation: 46 CPU tests passed, 24 scheduler warnings in 8.73s; no Ascend/FSDP hardware validation
optional_initialization: INIT_MODE=scratch: seeded random regular DFlash drafter; frozen pretrained target/embeddings/head retained; not the published warm-start recipe
optional_memory_adapter: HEAD_LOSS_CHUNK_SIZE>0: full-vocabulary CE in checkpointed prediction-row chunks, same mathematical weighted loss; no carrier detach; floating reduction order may differ

optional_packing.tail_policy: repeat at most world_size-1 packs; no dropped records
optional_packing.loop_rng: uniform step-keyed stream, identical stage count across ranks
optional_packing.teacher: Qwen3 backbone; unused vocabulary projection skipped
